---
# The template's body. Its title, abstract, keywords, authorship,
# acknowledgments, funding, and correspondence live in _quarto.yml; the
# blind copy renders with --profile blind and its format omits the identity
# (see _quarto-blind.yml; ssus_papers.submit stages the bundle). A paper
# created by `quarto use template` renames this file and keeps pointing at
# those files.
---

The masthead carries the working-paper identity; the body demonstrates the
type it governs — *italic*, **bold** (SemiBold), `code` set in IBM Plex Mono
and colored Blueprint, a variable $\lambda_k = \rho \sum_j w_{kj} x_j$ in IBM
Plex Math, and a footnote[^1].

| Surface | Set in |
|---|---|
| Title | Libre Franklin ExtraBold |
| Series line | IBM Plex Mono, letter-spaced |
| Body | IBM Plex Serif |
| Mathematics | IBM Plex Math |

[^1]: Footnotes set small in IBM Plex Serif.
